$comment: Conformance vectors for the `copilot.toolTelemetry` key on ToolCallState._meta, delivered on the chat/toolCallComplete action. See ../tool-call.md for the prose spec and ./README.md for the harness contract. `projectFromSdk` drives the real host helper from a ToolExecutionCompleteData (camelCase wire JSON) and wraps the produced value under the key; `set` / `extract` pin the portable insert / read convention (including coexistence with the AHP-native `ui` key); `wireShape` pins the serialized chat/toolCallComplete carrier. Object comparison is order-insensitive, so the host's sorted-key output-stability rule is pinned separately by a Rust unit test.

tests.name: projectFromSdk: carries the tool_telemetry map verbatim under the key
projectFromSdk: preserves nested value shapes verbatim
projectFromSdk: returns no _meta when tool_telemetry is absent
projectFromSdk: returns no _meta when tool_telemetry is an empty map
set: stamps the key onto an empty _meta
set: preserves the AHP-native `ui` key stamped at start
tests.$comment: The reducer replaces _meta wholesale on the complete transition, so the host re-includes the start-stamped `ui` block alongside the telemetry.

tests.name: extract: returns the telemetry object when present and non-empty
extract: returns null when _meta is absent
extract: returns null when _meta lacks the key
extract: returns null when the value is an empty object
tests.$comment: The host never emits an empty telemetry object; a non-conformant producer that does is treated as 'no telemetry'.

tests.name: extract: returns null when the value is a number (wrong type)
wireShape: a chat/toolCallComplete with telemetry and a coexisting `ui` key serializes to the flat-dotted _meta plus camelCase result
